gloss: to play an active role; to be active; to flourish

definitions.gloss: to play an active role; to be active; to distinguish oneself
definitions.explanation: To perform prominently or make significant contributions in a particular field, event, or arena.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{活躍|かつやく}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is active on the world stage.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{活躍|かつやく}した。
examples.english: The young athletes performed brilliantly at the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{映画|えいが}{監督|かんとく}→映画監督：07093_eigakantoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{活躍|かつやく}してきた。
examples.english: He has been active as a film director for many years.

examples.japanese: AI⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{活躍|かつやく}する⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧になった。
examples.english: We've entered an era where AI plays an active role in various fields.

notes:
A very common word in news and daily conversation. Always carries a positive connotation — it implies notable, praiseworthy activity. Often used when describing someone's career achievements or contributions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: outstanding performance
- ⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: arena of activity, place to shine
- ⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}される→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧: expected to play an active role
- {第一線|だいいっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{活躍|かつやく}する: to be active on the front lines
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{活躍|かつやく}する: to be active in a wide range of areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be active, to carry out activities — neutral, doesn't imply distinction
- ⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧: to do one's best — focuses on effort rather than results
- ⟦{奮闘|ふんとう}→奮闘：07901_funtou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fight hard, to struggle — emphasizes striving against difficulties
